Conditions signalled by gatekeepR

Source: R/utils-conditions.R
gatekeepR-conditions.Rd

All errors raised by gatekeepR inherit from gatekeepr_error and carry one specific class, so that code can react to a particular failure with tryCatch() or rlang::try_fetch(). Warnings inherit from gatekeepr_warning.

ClassWhen
gatekeepr_error_configinvalid panel, hierarchy, policy or configuration
gatekeepr_error_structurerequired markers or features missing from the cell table
gatekeepr_error_inputan argument has the wrong type or value
gatekeepr_error_ledgeran invalid ledger row or target
gatekeepr_error_confirma destructive operation without confirm = TRUE
gatekeepr_error_lockedan attempt to modify a locked snapshot
gatekeepr_error_lockfilea review working directory is held by another session
gatekeepr_error_verifyexport verification failed
gatekeepr_error_dependencya suggested package needed for this step is missing
gatekeepr_error_statean object is not in the state a step needs
gatekeepr_warning_uncallablemarkers not callable on an image (with list)
gatekeepr_warning_disabled_rulesrules disabled on an image (with list)
